title: Add a Use Case

narrative_arc.enters_knowing: They want to extend the pipeline for a new data source or target ontology.
narrative_arc.leaves_knowing: Two adaptation paths (new source type vs. new target ontology), what to change in each, configuration table.
steps: Two dimensions intro: new source type vs. new target ontology — independent choices
Path A: new source type — deploy or write extractor → produces JSON-LD → rest unchanged. Four options: deploy existing extractor, extend existing, write new FastAPI service, use RDFConverter direct
Path B: new target ontology — design pattern in OntosphereIO → MapToMethod generates mapping → rest unchanged
Configuration changes for each path: formats list, plugin list, exact vs. best_match strategy
When to use two-stage SPARQL CONSTRUCT (complex ontology alignment) vs. direct YARRRML/RML
Checklist: done when extractor produces JSON-LD, mapping has rules_skipped == 0, joined Turtle visible in CKAN

inline_assets_required.description: Decision tree diagram (code block, ASCII or Mermaid): New use case → [new source] or [new target ontology], each branch shows what changes and what stays the same.
Configuration snippet showing how to add a new format to CKANINI__CKANEXT__CSVTOCSVW__FORMATS and a new plugin to CKAN__PLUGINS.
Configuration changes table: Path | Config key | What to change | Default. Covers formats, plugins, mapping_strategy.

quality_gate: Both adaptation paths (source / ontology) present with distinct sections
Four extractor options for new source type listed
OntosphereIO linked as pattern authoring tool for new ontology path
Two-stage vs. direct YARRRML comparison (link to samm-catena-x.md)
notes: Page is partial. Main gap: source-type options need more concrete guidance (which existing extractor to reuse, minimal interface a new extractor must satisfy — produces JSON-LD as output). Check omeroextractor-service.json and openbismantic-service.json for extractor interface description.

primary.name: Domain Scientist
knows: Their scientific domain deeply (materials science, microscopy, lab procedures)
Measurement concepts and experimental workflows they consider universal
Domain-specific tools (OMERO, ELN systems, instrument software)
does_not_know: Ontology terms like PMDCO, CHAMEO, EMMO even if these describe their own work
How ontologies model domain concepts — that this modeling discipline exists at all
SPARQL, RDF, or any semantic technology
primary.goal: Upload their data, trigger the pipeline, and use or export FAIR-compliant results.
primary.key_gap: Double gap: (1) no semantic web knowledge whatsoever, and (2) domain experts frequently assume their concepts are universal common knowledge when they are not — documentation must not assume shared domain vocabulary and must explain what gets modeled and why, not just how.

secondary.name: Data Engineer
secondary.goal: Connect data sources, author mappings, and query transformation results.
